name: mvp non-convergence owner escape — second FAIL with no outstanding changes routes to the owner review gate (PHASE-55 W-2, R-16, closes PHASE-54 R-45)
description: R-16 predicate, direct engine: FAIL #1 at graph iteration 0 with no outstanding owner changes takes the internal A-5 loop_back byte-identically (R-16(e) false — A-5 keeps its one free self-repair attempt). After the normal return to RUN_TESTS, FAIL #2 at iterationCount=1 (graph truth from get_status, never the mvp_loop.iteration display echo) fires the escape: _mvpEnterOwnerReview with kind FAIL_REVIEW — advance suppressed, mvp_review_pending, graph held at RUN_TESTS with no increment, block BUILDING→AWAITING_OWNER_REVIEW, persisted report carries the failing assertion reasons verbatim and the owner-decides summary. R-10's outstanding-changes branch takes precedence and stays byte-identical (locked by S377).
